## Pantheon Platform - Senior Software Engineer, Connectivity – API Transformation

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/pantheon/jobs/8226934)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building Pantheon’s cloud WebOps connectivity and API platform. Designing federated APIs, distributed services, networking, and workflow orchestration at scale.
Senior Software Engineer building Pantheon’s cloud WebOps connectivity and API platform
- Salary: $139,680 - $174,600 per year
- Tech stack: Cassandra, Cloud, Distributed Systems, DNS, Docker, Drupal, Google Cloud Platform, Grafana, GraphQL, GRPC, Kubernetes, MySQL, Prometheus, Python, Redis, Rust, Terraform, Vault
- Build and evolve Pantheon's unified API: a federated GraphQL supergraph and Go subgraphs serving the Dashboard and public API
- Shape service connectivity through VPC and network architecture, service discovery strategy, and internal traffic standards
- Decompose a large legacy Python monolith into well-bounded services and own the Cassandra data layer, including replication, backup, and disaster recovery
- Design and operate workflow orchestration at platform scale using GCP Workflows, Pub/Sub-driven job execution, and Go services on Cloud Run
- Set GraphQL, gRPC, and REST standards for other engineering teams and serve as a technical resource across the organization
- Own production systems, track health with SLOs, resolve production issues, and balance delivery speed with reliability
- Participate in on-call engineering and alert response rotations
- Raise engineering quality through code review, design feedback, and mentorship
- Significant work experience building and operating production services in Go, with adaptability to work in a polyglot codebase including Rust and Python
- Experience designing APIs with schema design, versioning, and backward compatibility judgment; GraphQL, gRPC, or REST at scale
- Work-related experience with large-scale, high-traffic distributed systems and scalable, robust services
- Experience carving services out of a monolith or evolving a legacy system incrementally while keeping it running
- Working knowledge of cloud networking fundamentals: VPCs, DNS, load balancing, and service-to-service authentication
- Understanding and working knowledge of Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and release engineering practices
- Experience with a major cloud provider; GCP especially welcome
- Experience with observability tooling such as Grafana Cloud, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building Pantheon’s cloud WebOps connectivity and API platform. Designing federated APIs, distributed services, networking, and workflow orchestration at scale.
Senior Software Engineer building Pantheon’s cloud WebOps connectivity and API platform
Role description:
• Build and evolve Pantheon's unified API: a federated GraphQL supergraph and Go subgraphs serving the Dashboard and public API
• Shape service connectivity through VPC and network architecture, service discovery strategy, and internal traffic standards
• Decompose a large legacy Python monolith into well-bounded services and own the Cassandra data layer, including replication, backup, and disaster recovery
• Design and operate workflow orchestration at platform scale using GCP Workflows, Pub/Sub-driven job execution, and Go services on Cloud Run
• Set GraphQL, gRPC, and REST standards for other engineering teams and serve as a technical resource across the organization
• Own production systems, track health with SLOs, resolve production issues, and balance delivery speed with reliability
• Participate in on-call engineering and alert response rotations
• Raise engineering quality through code review, design feedback, and mentorship
Role requirements:
• Significant work experience building and operating production services in Go, with adaptability to work in a polyglot codebase including Rust and Python
• Experience designing APIs with schema design, versioning, and backward compatibility judgment; GraphQL, gRPC, or REST at scale
• Work-related experience with large-scale, high-traffic distributed systems and scalable, robust services
• Experience carving services out of a monolith or evolving a legacy system incrementally while keeping it running
• Working knowledge of cloud networking fundamentals: VPCs, DNS, load balancing, and service-to-service authentication
• Understanding and working knowledge of Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and release engineering practices
• Experience with a major cloud provider; GCP especially welcome
• Experience with observability tooling such as Grafana Cloud, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry
• Experience supporting live sites and participating in on-call
• Clear communication skills and ability to represent contributions and ideas clearly while remaining open to others
• Visa sponsorship is not available at this time
• Bonus points: GraphQL Federation, federation gateways or routers, schema registries, Rust, Cassandra, stateful datastores, legacy runtime migrations, private service networking, service meshes, GCP Workflows, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Build, AlloyDB, MySQL, Redis, Docker, CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Vault, WordPress, Drupal
Benefits:
• Industry competitive compensation and equity plan
• Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Sick Leave (PSL) and 11 Paid Company Holidays
• Full medical coverage (Extended health care, dental, vision)
• Top-of-line equipment
• Monthly allowance for wellness, reading and access to LinkedIn Learning for continued development
• Events and activities both team-based and company wide that inspire, educate and cultivate
• Bonus
Tech stack:
Cassandra, Cloud, Distributed Systems, DNS, Docker, Drupal, Google Cloud Platform, Grafana, GraphQL, GRPC, Kubernetes, MySQL, Prometheus, Python, Redis, Rust, Terraform, Vault, WordPress, Go
